headline: President Bush creates an advisory panel to study and suggest changes to the federal tax system.
what_it_does: This order sets up the President's Advisory Panel on Federal Tax Reform. Based on its title, the panel's job is to study the federal tax system and give advice on possible changes. An advisory panel makes suggestions only. It does not change any tax laws or rates by itself.

who_it_affects.how: Nothing changes for taxpayers right away, but the panel's advice could shape future tax proposals.

when_it_takes_effect: 2005-01-07, the date the order was signed
